# CivicTech Perú — AI-Agent & Citizen Transparency Guide

## Portal Web (`apps/web`)
- `/` — Dashboard de transparencia municipal (KPIs: `kpi-datasets`, `kpi-versions`, `kpi-integrity`; tarjetas `dataset-card`; insignia criptográfica de cadena de auditoría `audit-chain-status` dentro de `AUDIT TIMELINE`; panel de alertas fiscales `anomalies-panel` con enlace de exportación `ocds-export-link`).
- `/expenses` — Explorador de gastos públicos en Soles (PEN) con filtros (`entity`, `category`, `from`, `to`), total exacto (`expenses-total`), tabla (`expenses-table`), filas (`expense-row`) y exportación OCDS (`expenses-ocds-link`).
- `/report` — Flujo ciudadano en pasos (`report-step` con `data-step="1|2|3|4"`):
  1. Borrador anónimo (`report-category`, `report-description`, `report-create-btn`).
  2. Evidencia opcional con SHA-256 calculado localmente en navegador (`report-continue-btn`).
  3. Confirmación y envío (`report-submit-btn`).
  4. Confirmación con código de recibo anónimo único (`report-receipt-code`, mostrado una sola vez y no recuperable).
  - Alertas accesibles en `report-status-alert` (`aria-live="polite"`).
- `/reports` — Seguimiento anónimo por recibo (`receipt-tracker-form`, `receipt-code-input`, `receipt-track-btn`, `receipt-track-result` con `aria-live="polite"`) y listado público de reportes verificados y publicados (`public-report-card`).
- `/reports/$id` — Expediente público redactado (`public-report-detail`, `public-evidence-count`).

### Municipality Scoping & Global Controls
- Query parameter: `?municipality_id=<id>` (valores soportados: `lima`, `arequipa`, `cusco`, `trujillo`; por defecto `lima`).
- Selectores y navegación determinística:
  - `data-testid="municipality-select"`
  - `data-testid="topbar-search-input"`
  - `data-testid="cta-new-report"`
  - `data-testid="live-sync-badge"`
  - `data-testid="mobile-bottom-nav"`

## Admin & Moderation Console (`apps/admin`)
- `/` — Cola de moderación (requiere Bearer token en memoria: `admin-token-input`, `admin-token-apply`, `admin-token-clear`, `admin-auth-state` con `data-state="authenticated|unauthenticated"`, `admin-municipality-select`).
  - Tabla `moderation-queue-table`, filas `case-row` (`data-status`), acciones en español: `Triaje` (`case-action-triage`), `Verificar` (`case-action-verify`), `Rechazar` (`case-action-reject`), `Publicar` (`case-action-publish`), formulario (`moderation-reason-input`, `moderation-public-text-input`, `moderation-submit-btn`).
- `/ingest` — Ingesta CSV idempotente (`ingest-run-btn`, `ingest-checksum`, `ingest-deduplicated` con `data-deduplicated="true|false"`).

## Go API Discovery URLs (`services/api`, default `http://localhost:8080`)
- OpenAPI 3.1 contract: `GET /openapi.json`
- API LLM guide: `GET /llms.txt`
- Agent capability manifest: `GET /.well-known/agent.json`
- Health & metrics: `GET /health`, `GET /metrics`
- Public endpoints: `GET /public/datasets`, `GET /public/expenses`, `GET /public/reports`, `GET /public/reports/{id}`, `GET /public/audit/verify`, `GET /public/reports/track` (requires `X-Receipt-Code` header, never in URL query), `GET /public/ocds/releases.json`, `GET /public/anomalies`
- Citizen report lifecycle: `POST /reports` (supports `Idempotency-Key`), `POST /reports/{id}/evidence`, `POST /reports/{id}/submit`
- Moderation & admin (Bearer auth): `GET /moderation/cases`, `POST /moderation/cases/{id}/{triage|verify|reject}`, `POST /moderation/reports/{id}/publish`, `POST /admin/ingest/demo`

## Privacy & Audit Rules
- Zero PII in public responses, error messages, or logs: omit witness names, DNI, phones, emails, and sensitive locations.
- Internal storage identifiers (`storage_ref`, S3 object keys, raw backend stack traces) are never exposed in public portal views.
- Report lifecycle enforces strict auditable transitions with no skipped states: `DRAFT -> SUBMITTED -> TRIAGED -> VERIFIED -> PUBLISHED` (or `REJECTED` from `SUBMITTED`/`TRIAGED`).
- Evidence files are immutable after upload and only accepted while the report is in `DRAFT`.

## Exact Integer-Cent Currency Policy (PEN)
- Monetary amounts NEVER use floating-point arithmetic (`float`/`number` decimals).
- Backend DTOs provide `amount_cents` (`int64` exact integer cents, e.g. `125075` = `S/ 1,250.75`) and exact decimal `amount` string.
- Frontend totals and formatting use `BigInt` integer-cent arithmetic (`sumExpenseCents`, `formatBigIntCentsPEN`, `formatCentsPEN`) and `BigInt` integer percentage math.
